classification_definitions.exact: A completed structured full write established the bytes; every replayed structured edit matched exactly once; no unresolved later mutation controls the final state.
classification_definitions.high-confidence: A completed terminal operation with literal, statically resolvable content or source paths was replayed without executing the command; no unresolved later mutation controls the final state.
classification_definitions.partial: At least one full version was recovered, but a later successful structured or terminal mutation could not be placed or reproduced conclusively.
classification_definitions.unrecoverable: No complete byte state could be established from a successful recorded full write or deterministic terminal operation; any available edit fragments are retained separately.
